West Bengal Makes 'Ramayana' Film Tax-Free

West Bengal Chief Minister Suvendu Adhikari announced that the film 'Ramayana' has been made tax-free in the state. The announcement was made on Dussehra. The film stars Ranbir Kapoor and Yash.
